description: This file contains utility functions for formatting currency amounts, with special handling for USD, including support for dynamic decimal precision, optional inclusion of credits equivalent, and formatting helpers.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits appended. Supports dynamic precision based on value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amount with credits appended.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places, including thousands separators.
